spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on sparse grass and bare earth against a plain off-white background. It has the overall body shape, fur, head, and limbs of a shaggy domestic goat, with long coarse fur that is dark brown on the neck, chest, back and upper legs and creamy off-white on the belly and lower legs. The head is goat-like with a blunt muzzle, dark nose, brown eye, closed mouth and a tufted beard under the chin, topped with two thick curved horns. Embedded in the fur along the dorsal midline from the shoulders to the rump is a large, glossy, domed patch of polygonal plates with a mottled amber, dark brown and black tortoiseshell pattern; smaller patches of the same patterned plates occur on the side of the shoulder, the side of the thigh, the lower legs and the tip of the short fluffy tail.

parts.looks_like: goat-like head with short to medium brown fur, paler fur around the muzzle, a dark nostril, a visible brown eye with eyelid, a closed mouth, and a tuft of longer hair forming a beard under the chin
parts.where: at the anterior right end of the body, atop the neck, facing right in profile

parts.looks_like: two thick, ridged, keratinous horns, dark gray-brown to black, with transverse growth rings, tapering to pointed tips and curving backward and slightly outward
parts.where: arising from the top of the head just behind and above the ears, the nearer right horn partially overlapping the left horn

parts.looks_like: two triangular pointed ears with brown outer fur and lighter inner fur, upright
parts.where: on the sides of the head behind the horns, the right ear fully visible in profile and the left ear partially visible behind the horns

parts.looks_like: very long, shaggy, wavy dark brown fur forming a thick ruff, coarser and longer than the body fur
parts.where: along the dorsal and ventral neck extending from behind the ears down over the throat, chest and shoulders

parts.looks_like: four sturdy columnar legs covered in long shaggy fur, brown on the upper portions and creamy off-white on the lower portions
parts.where: beneath the torso, two forelegs under the chest and two hindlegs under the rump, standing on the ground, left legs partially obscured behind right legs

parts.looks_like: four cloven hooves, each with two toes capped in dark brown horn with a central cleft, with short light fur at the coronet above the hoof
parts.where: at the distal ends of the four legs in contact with the ground

parts.looks_like: short, fluffy tail covered in long shaggy fur, creamy at the base and brown toward the tip, with a small patch of tortoiseshell pattern at the very tip
parts.where: projecting from the posterior rump at the left end of the body, held slightly raised

parts.looks_like: a large elongated-oval, slightly domed, hard glossy covering made of many polygonal scutes with a mottled tortoiseshell pattern of amber-yellow, dark brown and black with dark borders
parts.where: embedded in the fur along the dorsal midline of the back, extending from behind the shoulders to above the rump

parts.looks_like: individual hard glossy polygonal plates with the same amber-brown-black tortoiseshell mottling, about 15-20 in the large dorsal patch and smaller clusters of 4-7 plates, plus small irregular dark mottled patches
parts.where: large contiguous patch on the mid-back, plus isolated clusters on the lateral side of the right foreleg shoulder and right hindleg thigh, and small patches near the lower forelegs, lower hindlegs and tail tip

parts.looks_like: mottled tortoiseshell pattern of amber, brown and black on the plates, contrasting with the solid brown and cream fur
parts.where: on all plate clusters on the back, shoulder, thigh, lower legs and tail tip

meta_spark.description: A stocky four-legged animal with the body, head and coat of a shaggy brown and cream goat, standing in side view facing right. It has a bearded goat head with curved ridged horns, pointed ears, long shaggy neck and torso fur, four slender legs ending in dark cloven hooves, and a short fluffy tail. Across the middle of its back is a patch of glossy polygonal plates with black, brown and yellow tortoise-shell mottling, with smaller patches of the same mottled pattern showing through the fur on the shoulders, thighs, lower legs and tail tip.
